info.name: POS API — 1.0
info.description:
Authenticated point-of-sale operations for branch selection, POS catalog browsing, inventory visibility, POS sale completion, and POS order lookup

Generated from `docs/api/openapi/pos.openapi.json` by `pnpm docs:postman`. Edit the generator, not this file.

item.name: 00 · Setup — sign in
item.description: Run this first. It registers (or reuses) a merchant owner, signs in, and stores `accessToken`, `merchantId` and `merchantSlug` for every other folder.

request.description: A 409 means the owner already exists from an earlier run; the sign-in below still works.

item.name: Complete a one-shot POS sale and return a receipt (deprecated)

request.description:
Legacy single-call sale endpoint: bypasses device/shift tracking and marks the order paid directly without creating a Payment record. Prefer POST /pos/devices + POST /pos/shifts + POST /pos/orders + POST /pos/orders/:orderId/payments, which support split/multi-tender payments, kitchen workflow, and proper payment ledger records.

`POST /pos/sales`

Operation id: `PosController_createSale`

Documented responses: **201**
